title: Shortcut Learning in Generalist Robot Policies: The Role of Dataset Diversity and Fragmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating robot policies in simulation (LIBERO) and real-world environments on out-of-distribution (OOD) configurations where task-irrelevant visual factors (like camera viewpoints and backgrounds) are varied or swapped. The paper measures if the model incorrectly relies on these dataset artifact shortcuts rather than the actual language instructions and target objects.
